stage: frozen after metadata selection and before any target historical source or patch read
purpose: One bounded independent test of the already developed single-revision host-to-endian field producer checker; no rule changes before saving raw outputs.
input: Exactly the three old revisions and one path each in final_synthesis_repr_selection_pre.json. The checker may follow only its implemented two levels of quoted local includes at the same revision. Fix commits are never scanner inputs.
predeclared_outputs: candidate only for a host-typed same-width scalar directly assigned to a declared __le*/__be* struct field without conversion, followed by same-function address passing of that object; this is a review lead, not a defect verdict
normal applies only to that analyzed assignment if its source representation is known compatible, an explicit conversion is proven, or it is zero; it does not clear the commit
insufficient for unknown RHS type, unsupported transformation, declaration ambiguity, or missing consumer boundary; no promotion to candidate from a title or later patch
zero recognized assignments is rule out of scope for that selected path; missing file or invocation failure is runner_error
save all three raw JSON files and SHA-256 hashes before reading the fix body/diff; only then audit actual mechanism, supported configuration, and whether candidate lines match
count independent causal chains by commit after source review, never by assignment or input path; purposeful selection precludes precision, recall or speed claims
stop_rule: Do not replace these targets after seeing outputs. If neither possible positive matches this narrow shape, report that same-mechanism transfer was not tested and close this bounded route.
